definitions.gloss: certainty; reliability; sureness; degree of certainty
definitions.explanation: The quality of being certain or reliable — the extent to which something can be counted on to happen or be true. Used when evaluating predictions, plans, methods, or outcomes.

examples.japanese: {確実性|かくじつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Choose the method with higher certainty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{確実性|かくじつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やした→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: We increased the data to improve the reliability of predictions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{速|はや}さ→速さ：28072_hayasa⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{確実性|かくじつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: We set the surgical approach prioritizing certainty over speed.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {確実性|かくじつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high certainty; highly reliable
- {確実性|かくじつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low certainty
- {確実性|かくじつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve certainty
- {確実性|かくじつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧: to emphasize reliability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正確性|せいかくせい}→正確性：05801_seikakusei⟧: accuracy — how close to the true value, not how dependable
- ⟦{信頼性|しんらいせい}→信頼性：05572_shinraisei⟧: trustworthiness — reliability of a person or system over time
